purpose: A 50-variant, SNV-only, temporally post-AlphaGenome OpenSplice benchmark for causal circuit analysis. Selection was frozen before any local AlphaGenome inference.

v1_infeasibility.reason: The predeclared v1 requirement for three significant negative and three significant positive variants per exon was infeasible because BRAF_e14 had zero significant negative effects.
v1_infeasibility.disposition: v1 remains unchanged and has no selected-variant artifact. v2 keeps the same five frozen exons, drops the forced sign balance, and restricts the primary causal-patching benchmark to exact SNVs.

temporal_holdout_scope.statement: OpenSplice was posted after AlphaGenome's original publication/evaluation, so it is a temporal holdout from AlphaGenome training and original evaluation. It is not model-blind in the stronger sense because the OpenSplice authors subsequently benchmarked AlphaGenome on the dataset.

inspected_files.role: Defines Supplementary Table 4 experimental columns, quality statistics and hg38 coordinate merge.
Publishes the ordered 30-exon curated example list from which the first five were frozen without consulting model scores.
Maps curated exon labels to genes, Ensembl exon IDs and GRCh38 exon coordinates.
Reference for upstream VCF parsing, strand handling and fixed genomic-window semantics; its model scores are not used for selection.
Reference for VCF deletion anchoring and REF-to-ALT coordinate realignment; its model scores are not used for selection.

dataset_release.title: OpenSplice: the impact of half a million mutations on the alternative splicing of 600 human exons

required_files.name: open_splice_experimental_master_unique_sequence_all_predictor_cols.tsv.gz
required_files.role: Measured PSI, replicate PSI, delta-logit-PSI, uncertainty, significance, region and mutation class. The file also contains existing predictor columns, which are prohibited selection inputs and ignored by an explicit allowlist in select_holdout_v2.py.

required_files.name: opensplice_predictors_benchmarking_exon_metadata.tsv
required_files.role: Ensembl exon ID, strand and GRCh38 exon coordinates required to construct genomic AlphaGenome intervals.

required_files.name: alphagenome_genome_input_per_exon.zip
required_files.role: Exact GRCh38 VCF-like CHROM, POS, ID, REF and ALT values. Exact selected alleles must come from this archive, not be reconstructed from minigene position labels.

files_explicitly_not_required.name: opensplice_predictors_benchmarking_variant_metadata.tsv
files_explicitly_not_required.reason: Its 182.8 MB minigene sequence table is unnecessary for native-genome selection and inference.

files_explicitly_not_required.name: psi_per_barcode_*.tsv
files_explicitly_not_required.reason: Multi-gigabyte barcode-level inputs are unnecessary because the released variant-level table already applies the upstream error model and read filters.

files_explicitly_not_required.name: ENA PRJEB111846 raw reads
files_explicitly_not_required.reason: Raw read reprocessing is outside the small circuit benchmark.

files_explicitly_not_required.name: Supplementary Table 12 and every predictor-score column
files_explicitly_not_required.reason: Using existing AlphaGenome or comparator scores to choose exons or variants would leak model performance into the holdout.

frozen_exon_rule.rule: Carry forward unchanged the five exons mechanically frozen for v1: the first five entries, in source order, from the upstream 30-exon curated splice-map list. This is deterministic and independent of all predictor scores.

frozen_variant_rule.quality_gate: Keep measured non-WT variants with complete exact VCF mapping, three finite replicate PSI values and finite psi, wt_psi, delta_psi, delta_logit, se_d and padj values. For v2, also require mut_type='sub' and one-base REF and ALT alleles in the exact released VCF.
frozen_variant_rule.effect_rule: Among significant SNVs with padj < 0.1, choose the six largest absolute delta_logit values regardless of sign; break ties by variant_id. Record, but do not rebalance, the observed sign.
frozen_variant_rule.neutral_rule: For the first four selected effects, select an unused nonsignificant SNV with padj >= 0.1 and the smallest absolute delta_logit in the best available tier: same region and mutation type, same region, same mutation type, then any; break ties by variant_id.
frozen_variant_rule.indel_policy: Exclude deletions from the primary v2 causal-patching benchmark to avoid activation-alignment and indel-stitching confounds. Evaluate deletions only in a later, explicitly versioned sensitivity analysis.

output_contract.freeze_condition: The three pinned inputs passed their release checksums and the selector froze the canonical TSV before local AlphaGenome inference. Do not replace examples because AlphaGenome performs poorly.

model_evaluation_constraints.mechanistic_gate: Perform circuit recovery only for variants whose AlphaGenome output direction agrees with measured delta-logit-PSI; report the rejected fraction over all 30 high-effect variants.
model_evaluation_constraints.no_reselection: Model failures remain denominator observations and may not trigger replacement of an exon or variant.
